description: Cross-implementation PARITY contract. The Anchor program's litesvm test MUST reproduce `expected` from `inputs` using the shared deterministic crate (syndicate-shared), exactly as the off-chain pipeline does. This equality is the off-chain<->on-chain determinism guarantee (04 §18). Mirrors services/settlement/tests/e2e.rs::e2e_contested_showdown_parity_and_tamper_rejection and services/shared/tests/core.rs golden vectors.
scenario: 3-handed limped hand to showdown; blinds 1/2; each player contributes 2 (pot 6); seat 0 closest to S=100000.
